overview.description: The FT Vest Silver Strategy & Target Income ETF (SLVY) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in income alternatives. The fund aims to generate income from a long position in IShares Silver Trust (SLV) and call spreads utilizing FLEX options. The fund gains exposure through a wholly-owned subsidiary. SLVY was launched on Jul 8, 2026 and is issued by First Trust.
